outputs.explanation: Panel A is a spatial transcriptomics cluster micrograph, not a plot of averaged data; check not applicable.
Panel B shows H&E micrographs with manual region annotations, not a plot of averaged data; check not applicable.
Panel C combines H&E micrographs with spatial gene-expression heatmap overlays; heatmaps are exempt from requiring individual data points.
Panel D consists of GSEA enrichment plots, which are line plots and are exempt from requiring individual data points.
Panel E is a bar graph showing log2 fold-change (an aggregate differential expression value) per gene, but no individual data points, replicates, or variance are overlaid on the bars.
